name: memory_why_not
description: Explain why a specific memory was NOT returned for a query. Diagnoses: not found, deleted, suppressed, outranked (below topK), or eliminated by pre-filters (tags/valence/importance). Always runs in OBSERVE mode (no state mutations).

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to investigate.

query.description: The query it was expected to match.

top_k.description: The topK used in the original recall (default 5).
